summary.text: Pam Thayer is a Republican state representative from Wyoming who has represented House District 15 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is executive director of the Rawlins Downtown Development Authority/Main Street and formerly held an at-large seat on the Carbon County School District 1 board.

paragraphs.text: Pam Thayer's career experience includes working as executive director of the Rawlins Downtown Development Authority/Main Street.
She held an at-large seat in Carbon County School District 1 until 2024.
Thayer took office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Donald Burkhart.

In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and the House Labor, Health and Social Services Committee, along with the corresponding joint committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
